meta.title: Seedance 2.5 Flash vs Kling 4.0 Flash | MaxVideoAI
meta.description: Compare Seedance 2.5 Flash and Kling 4.0 Flash on MaxVideoAI: clip length, visual references, audio controls, editing workflows and current prices.

en.heroIntro: Two Flash models with different reference and editing controls. Kling 4.0 Flash generates 3–20 second scenes at 720p with native audio directed in the prompt. Seedance 2.5 Flash offers 4–30 seconds at 480p or 720p, optional generated audio and separate edit and extension workflows. The shared Flash name does not establish equal latency or quality.

quickVerdict.title: Choose by the job
quickVerdict.body: Kling Flash accepts an opening image and visual references, but has no end-frame control, audio switch, Modify or Extend here. Seedance Flash separates these source workflows and accepts audio references alone or alongside visual inputs. Video reference guidance is different from editing a source clip.
